rule: Have startStatementSpan and startTransactionSpan return null unless the active span is recording (for example `true !== $this->currentSpan->span()?->isRecording()`), or keep CurrentSpan empty when the span is not recording, so tracing-off and unsampled requests really pay only one check.

rule: Make the repeats possessive, meaning the engine never backtracks into them, by writing `(?:\s++|--[^\n]*+(?:\n|\z)|\/\*.*?\*\/)*+`, or use plain `\s` in place of `\s+` inside the group, then add a test case with a long whitespace prefix before `(`.

fix: Make the repeats possessive, meaning the engine never backtracks into them, by writing `(?:\s++|--[^\n]*+(?:\n|\z)|\/\*.*?\*\/)*+`, or use plain `\s` in place of `\s+` inside the group, then add a test case with a long whitespace prefix before `(`.

rule: Make the inner whitespace match possessive (`\s++`) or wrap the whole skip group in an atomic group `(?>...)`, so a failed match costs time in line with the length of the SQL.
problem: The regex `(?:\s+|...)*` puts a repeat inside a repeat, so a statement that starts with a long run of whitespace and then a non-letter such as `(` makes PCRE try every way of splitting that whitespace until it hits the backtrack limit, and that runs on every traced statement.
fix: Make the inner whitespace match possessive (`\s++`) or wrap the whole skip group in an atomic group `(?>...)`, so a failed match costs time in line with the length of the SQL.
